label: Escape probability
subgoals: Compute the probability that one vector misses the bug
Raise it to the number of vectors
Compare with an equivalence check that cannot miss

label: Vectors for a target escape rate
section: Vectors for a target escape rate
subgoals: Take the log of the target escape probability
Divide by the log of one minus the bug's hit rate
Round up to the next whole vector

label: Inflated pass rates
subgoals: Multiply the incorrect share by the false-pass probability
Subtract the true rate to get the inflation
